notes.title: Patch Notes 1658
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here's the changelog for today's update, version 1658. Highlights include a new fatigue system to try and curb dash spam, workshop integration, and a much sexier Community. As always, there's a bunch of work being done behind the scenes, and Flux has put out a couple of videos demonstrating the progress on Pure, the new female character coming soon to Blade Symphony. You can check out some of her attacks here and here.

As always you can find our patch notes at our website.

Please note that our official gameplay servers are out of date and still require updating. Sorry about that.

General
Steam Workshop integration support: you can now create swords for the steam workshop and upload them via an in-game UI, and Blade Symphony now supports the Steam Workshop.Implemented a fatigue system where the more you perform some actions, the more tired you become and the less effective the action isSlows down rolling, dashing and jumpingSlows down movement if high fatigueFatigue wears off over timeHUD stance icon glows red to indicate fatigue levelBig update for Community with lots of graphical detail addedFixed client d/c'ing and crashing when connecting to a server with a custom mapChanged some vote cvars to be cheats protected so they can't be abusedReduced roll/shuffle movement by 25%Improved disconnection messageReduced hitstop for tracer parriesRemoved blur from shuffle as it was causing huge framerate loss in certain situationsAdded a vs_free_setffahealth command that sets the health of everyone who's not in a duel, in free serversAdded a ragdoll follow camera mode used when you die 
Balance
JudgementFast Left T2 increased lock time from 0.32 to 0.5 and damage reduced from 18 to 16Shortened startup tracers for Fast Left T1 and Fast Left T2Phalanx:Balanced left damage 20 -> 17Balanced right damage 20 -> 18Heavy S1 T1 damage 30 -> 33Heavy left t2 damage 24 -> 25, t3 damage 28 -> 30Heavy right t1 damage 20 -> 25, t2 damage 24 -> 27, t3 damage 28 -> 30Longsword:Air damage multiplier from 0.8 back to 1.0Charge time multiplier 1.4 -> 1.3Charge run multiplier 0.4 -> 0.6Scimitar:Removed knockback and tracer parry turningCan no longer interrupt opponent when attackingMade damage multiply by 25% every multi-hitReduced multihit rate from 0.032 to 0.034Decreased damage from 30% to 10%Increased minimum multihit damage from 3 to 8Jian: Air damage multiplier 1.5 -> 1.3 
Bug Fixes
Fixed config_default being excludedDisabled jumping during airmoves so you can't jump while you're landingFixed air attacks causing you to float if done very high above groundFixed dedicated servers and game client running on the same machine, the client can join nowFixed issue with tracer parries not handling their stance powers correctlyPossible fix for client showing wrong player model sometimesFixed ragdoll follow camera stucking in geometry when i.e. in waterFixed player camera clipping into some geometry during certain actionsFixed FFA mode respawning a player while in a private duel and waiting for a new round to start

notes.title: Longswords Patch 1548
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here's the changelog for patch #1548. Not listed here is a bunch of work done on Steam Workshop integration which Biohazard went over on our developer hangout, which you can tune into every Saturday at 7pm EST. Supporting the community and letting players implement their own swords is something we care greatly about, so expect this feature soon!Longswords have also gone live this patch! They have lower fast stance and air attack damage, but do double damage when breaking through a parry and hitting someone. Longswords have the Feint ability, which Foils used to have. They also have a higher than average charge time with a lower than average charge run speed, and cannot cancel side attacks into one another.

http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/berimbau-LONGSWORD2.jpg

http://www.blade-symphony.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/berimbau-LONGSWORD1.jpg


Gameplay
Longsword sword type added, including the following new selectable swords: Tone Death, Grave Requiem, Caduceus Chord, Gaelic OperaFeint now gets boosted run speed from chargingIncreased Ryoku fast attack tier 1 damage by 2Jian base damage increased from 75% to 85%Judgement: reduced heavy S1 T1 damage from 50 to 40Judgement: reduced heavy S2 T1 damage from 50 to 45Judgement: reduced balanced S2 T1 damage from 28 to 24Can now set what sword a bot is using
Bug Fixes
Default items will be available if a players client can't communicate with serverFixed some items being swapped when changing them mid roundFixed player origin not moving to new arena when switching arenas in duel watch mode (causing sounds/particles to not play and other problems)Head turn angle shouldn’t clip into chest as muchCharge sound is now client side to make it stop better with high ping and jitterImproved interpolation on remote playersFixed physics props simulating too fast with high pingScreenshake should no longer be amplified with higher pingFixed opponent moving around during grab with high pingOptimizations for players not being renderedTick rate should no longer affect tracersKneel/recovery attack set to balanced stance always so it doesn't have arbitrary behavior for some propertiesFixed SDK launcher and hammer default projects to work with Blade Symphony
Graphics & Sound
Update to district skybox, events play more oftenUpdated district and monastery soundscapesNew winter 2D skyboxRe-enabled Temple camera clipsFixed Monastery 2v2 spawns for cloister

notes.content:
Hi guys, here's the patch notes for the newest version of Blade Symphony that just went live on Steam, revision #1491. You can also see the patch notes on our site at: https://www.blade-symphony.com/2013/06/blade-symphony-patch-1498-changelog/

Gameplay
Foil now has “guard” for it’s block tech, a mobile defense that you can walk around that absorbs the first hit of an enemy’s attackPlayers can now vault over low walls when dashing into themYou can now wallrun diagonally and horizontally left and rightAdded cvar bot_ffa_duel to make bots duel in ffaPlayers now spawn near one another in ffa when engaged in a duel+walk implemented for fun and profit 
Balance
Ryoku fast string 1 t1 damage from 20->17 and lock duration from 0.55->0.58Judgement fast left and right t1 lock duration 0.63->0.75Phalanx balanced string 1 t1 damage 24->22Replaced phalanx balanced string 1 t2 animation with identical t1 animation, and made locktime 0.5->0.6Foil changes:Made thrust damage use the dot product as a bonus additive multiplier that adds on top of normal scaleFoil's damagedotproductx is 1.3 meaning attacks closest to the perfect "thrust" will get up 30% damage bonus (scaling)Foil forward attacks is now 0.5 powerFoil side attacks is now 0.6 powerscimitar damage scaling changed:Scimitar now has block instead of kick (pending new block tech)Scimitar multihit rate 0.0285->0.035 (slightly less multihits)Scimitar has reduced min damage 3->1Scimitar forward attack damage 0.4->0.1Scimitar side attack damage 0.4->0.36These are to compensate the changes from last revision where scimitar no longer has damage scaling (equal damage per hit)Scimitar knockback from 1.0 to 1.05Throwable weapon changes:Removed stun from throwable hit and block interruptsMade throwable weapon homing less effectiveMade it possible to block stars while charging t1Prevented stars from interrupting attacks, players just take damageWhile charging, players need to face star to block with normal autoblock rulesIncreased throwable damage to 15

Graphics/Mapping
Cleaned up district pipe work, converted to modelNew animation for jian interceptffa_community updates including a new arenaImplemented capesAdding continuous dust slide particle for when getting pushed back

notes.title: The 1337+1 Patch (r1338)
notes.content:
Hi all, Flux here bringing you patch notes today. And while I’m here I want you to know it was my 30th birthday this week!

See full patch notes here.

We’ve been watching players play and reading your feedback constantly. Some things we’ve noticed and are changing:


Phalanx balanced right is obviously broken. The amount of skill it takes to swing that attack over and over compared to what it takes to stop that strategy was disproportionate. We've toned it down a notch, without taking out thrill of using it in a combo. We’ll keep an eye on things like this when the patch gets in your hands.
Grab itself does a lot of damage, but by itself isn’t very interesting when it’s just a one click damage dealer. The interesting part is the followup when the opponent is on the ground. We’re still not totally happy with it the entire grab and throw sequence, but this change should make it less of a match-deciding factor.
The Scimitar was also giving out disproportionate amounts of damage and has been reduced from 50% damage output to 40%. This makes the the Scimitar rely more on multi-hits and less on attack damage itself. The scimitar is pretty incomplete since it lacks a good defensive tech which we’re still working on.
We've noticed that Tier2 and Tier3s are often eschewed by quick swipes of Tier1. We've boosted the damages of many Tier2 and Tier3 moves accordingly to make them more attractive options when fighting. Hopefully this will encourage more players to try charging attacks as well as using them to chase down opponents.
Similar to charged attacks, air attacks are often used by mistake since their damage output compared to the risk of using them is not balanced out. We've increased the damage to many air side attacks to make them more attractive.
Some forward attacks are far outshined by their side attack counterparts. We've increased the damage for certain forward attacks that have more attractive side attacks by making the forward ones more attractive. Specifically moves that aren’t used as often, such as Judgement’s fast forward strings and heavy strings.
Ryoku was and still is extremely lacking in options. We’re experimenting with some new attacks for him. See below.


Keep in mind we’re still painting with a pretty broad brush right now and not really settling in the super minute game balances because there are still quite a few moving parts. These changes are to shift the overall balance of power and attempt to reward skillful gameplay, and we’re still homing in on them so there’s going to be some changes that seem pretty huge. Compared to two months ago these changes are quite mild.

notes.title: The "Running with Scissors" Patch 1286
notes.content:
Breaking Note: We're aware there is a current screwup with some (lots) of our servers not being joinable, it only currently affects linux servers (as far as we can tell) and are working on fixing it asap, sorry guys

Your patch notes here.

Gameplay

Added experimental upper body only attack for judgement heavy left and right and Phalanx balanced left and right T1
Added experimental left/right attack canceling. When using side attacks, you can now cancel half of the current attack by attacking in the opposite direction.
You can no longer dash right after attacking. Attacking will effectively use up your dash cooldown
Air attacks now beat heavy stance in parries (but still lose to everything else).
Combo pushback amount increased back to before last patch.
Made air stun turns the player according to knockback direction.
Juggling is now possible again.
Made roll/shuffle reset turn rates so their movement feels less weird.
Made mirrored grabs cause deflection rather than stun/interrupt. Added a new animation for this.
Reduced penalty for sword clash vs world.
Turn penalty on hit is reduced.
Made soft collision during attacks stronger so players shouldn’t clip into each other as much
 

Phalanx

Slowing down Phalanx Balanced Right attacks slightly.
Slowing down Phalanx Balanced Left T2.
Replaced Phalanx Balanced Left T1 and Right T1 with moveable attacks.
Slowing down Phalanx Heavy Left and Right T2 and T3 to reflect the ability to cancel side attacks.
 

Ryoku

Reduced knockback for Ryoku Fast 3, 4, 5.
Slightly increased locktime for Ryoku Fast 6
Reduced startup time and speed for Ryoku Balanced Left Tier 1 and Balanced String 1 T1
Reduced lock time for Ryoku Air Left T1 and Right T1
 

Judgement

Replaced Judgement Heavy Left T1 and Right t1 with moveable attacks.
Adjusted these damages and lock times accordingly (damage from 40 to 30).
Slowed startup time for Judgement Balanced Left T1.
Slowed startup time for Judgement Balanced Forward T1.
 

Katana

Katana now takes chip damage on block (1 health per hit).
 

Throwable Weapons

Made throwables cancelable if throw star button is not held. They have a minimum cancel time as well.
Throwable weapons have no effect on players who charge to Tier 2 or above.
 

Graphics

New particle for blocking
Improved tracer visuals for landed attacks (matches up better now)
Improved neutral hit reaction stumble walk.
 

Global

You can now callvote and affect duel type per arena (1v1, 2v2, 2v1)
Duel type is now visible on scoreboard
Added a vote menu from Play Online sub menu
Added a vote yes and vote no binding (you should bind it from options)
When timer runs out the player with more health wins.
 

Maps

Fixed an issue players getting stuck on Winter Deck arena.
ffa_community updated.
Adjusted overall volume and balance of ambient sounds on District.
